messages:
Tess - AE: Heads-up: Emergent wants a 14-day POC to validate their fine-tuned 13B variant + embeddings. Requirements: streaming chat, embeddings endpoint, SSO, HIPAA. They want to BYOK.
Ibrahim - Sales Eng: Artifact details? quant/format?
Tess - AE: Customer says safetensors with LoRA adapter, exported q4_nf4, tokenizer.json included.
Sora - ML Eng: nf4 + LoRA usually works but need a scan. I'll run a quick compat check for tokenizer, kv cache, and streaming perf.
InfraBot: Capacity check: pool "poc-us-west" has 3x A100 available.
Sora - ML Eng: Scan summary: tokenizer loads, 10 OOV tokens -> mapping ok. Model loads but attention op at block 7 triggers legacy kernel fallback; adapter shim needed. Estimate 36-48h engineering + 24h perf validation. p50 expected ~100-120ms after tuning on A100.
Viv - Security: HIPAA requires Dedicated/Private + signed BAA/DPA before data ingest. BYOK OK on Private; need KMS ARN and key policy. I'll send sec questionnaire and BAA template.
Ibrahim - Sales Eng: Pricing proposal for 14-day POC: $5,000 reserved + $0.70 per 1k tokens over baseline, provisional until compatibility confirmed.
Tess - AE: Action items: Sora to open ENG ticket and post ETA, Viv to send security checklist, Ibrahim to send provisional quote and schedule kickoff. I'll ask Emergent for DPA/KMS within 3 business days.
Sora - ML Eng: Opened ticket ENG-8620 for adapter shim + streaming tests. ETA patch 48h, validation 24h.
Tess - AE: Thanks team ";"
